deep_dive.executive_summary: MIAX is a multi-venue U.S. and Bermuda exchange operator (options, equities, futures, market data) built on in-house technology. FY2025 revenue grew ~20% to $1.36 billion while normalized free cash flow was about $2.08 per share (operating cash flow minus capital spending). Q1 2026 revenue was $370 million (+13% year over year). At ~$40.32 (Stooq, 2026-06-03), the base Lawrence path implies 11.0% per year over seven years; total synthesis is 13.3% per year after scenario weighting. Bull case 17.4% if futures clearing (OCC agreement, May 2026 press) and Pearl/Emerald share gains compound. Dh...
